exposure: postnatal weight loss patterns (>5% of birth weight, <=5% of birth weight)
failure to regain birth weight by day 10
mode of birth (cesarean vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: The study included 1101 healthy, singleton infants who attended health centers in Kermanshah, Iran.
finding: Greater early postnatal weight loss combined with failure to regain birth weight by day 10 was associated with reduced exclusive breastfeeding duration and lower infant weight at two years.
mod_finding: Postnatal weight loss was higher in infants born via cesarean delivery compared to vaginal delivery.
